content.text: {"class": "TEST_CODE_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The setup POST returned 422 (currency missing) and the @BeforeMethod extracted orderId without any status assertion, so the test carried on with a null id and requested GET /api/v1/orders/null. Under the fixture tie-break, a setup call that actually failed with a non-2xx which the test did not check is TEST_CODE_DEFECT, not TEST_DATA — and the 404 is the product correctly answering an invalid request. The release note 'feat: require currency on order creation' with a contract bump also makes the test's payload stale rather than the product wrong."}
